text: Every dimension now exists and is populated, so this lesson finally loads the fact table itself, and then checks that the load actually worked.

The INSERT joins Sales.SalesOrderDetail and SalesOrderHeader against all four dimensions, matching on each dimension's AlternateKey column — translating real-world source IDs into the warehouse's own surrogate keys, one join at a time.

Two plain COUNT star queries, one against the source and one against the warehouse, have to return the exact same number. If they don't, some order line failed to resolve in one of the joins and was silently dropped — real information a feeling that the load 'probably worked' would never catch.
Next lesson, the business asks for something this warehouse wasn't originally built to hold — and you'll trace that change through every layer that depends on it.
